ordered_diagnoses: Undifferentiated embryonal sarcoma of the liver

s1.syndrome_frame: Abdominal pain with liver dysfunction and a large cystic liver tumor
salient_findings: Right dorsal pain
Elevated alkaline phosphatase and γ-glutamyl transferase
Large cystic liver tumor with solid components
Depressed liver function
Elevated tumor markers DUPAN-2 and CA125
key_facts: Negative hepatitis B and C viral markers
Normal α-fetoprotein, PIVKA-II, CEA, and CA19-9 levels
16 cm diameter cystic tumor in the right hepatic lobe and medial segment of the left lobe
Tumor compressing the umbilical portion of the portal vein, the right portal vein, and the left hepatic vein

shortlist: Undifferentiated embryonal sarcoma of the liver

shortlist.label: Mucinous cystadenocarcinoma of the liver
shortlist.why_kept: Large cystic liver tumor with solid components and septa, consistent with imaging findings

shortlist.label: Hepatic sarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Cystic tumor with solid components and high FDG uptake on PET-CT, suggesting malignant potential

shortlist.label: Intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated alkaline phosphatase and gamma-glutamyl transferase, suggesting biliary obstruction or cholangiocarcinoma

shortlist.label: Biliary cystadenoma
shortlist.why_kept: Cystic tumor with septa and solid components, although less likely given the patient's age and tumor size

shortlist.label: Undifferentiated embryonal sarcoma of the liver
shortlist.why_kept: Large cystic tumor with solid components and aggressive features, although rare and less likely

raw.rationale: The presence of a large, multilocular cystic tumor with septa and solid components, elevated DUPAN-2 and CA125 levels, and the tumor's appearance on imaging studies are consistent with mucinous cystadenocarcinoma of the liver

rejected.label: Hepatic sarcoma
rejected.why: While sarcoma is a consideration, the presence of mucin-producing cells and the specific tumor markers suggest mucinous cystadenocarcinoma

rejected.label: Intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma
rejected.why: The tumor's appearance and markers are not typical for intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma

rejected.label: Biliary cystadenoma
rejected.why: The presence of solid components and the patient's age suggest a malignant process rather than a benign cystadenoma

rejected.label: Undifferentiated embryonal sarcoma of the liver
rejected.why: The tumor's appearance and markers are not consistent with undifferentiated embryonal sarcoma
